title: Poppy Crown Queen
description: A close-up portrait of a green-skinned woman with cracked texture, purple eye makeup, and a wide smile. She wears an ornate golden crown adorned with red poppies, holds a broken piece of the crown in her hand, while red poppy petals and golden leaves float around her against a dramatic stormy sky with green lightning.
prompt: A close-up portrait of a woman with vibrant green cracked skin and purple eyeshadow, smiling widely, wearing an ornate golden crown decorated with red poppies. She holds a broken piece of the crown in her hand as red poppy petals and golden leaves swirl around her. Dramatic stormy sky with swirling dark clouds and bright green lightning in the background, fantasy style, rich textures and dramatic lighting.
